caption: This shoyu ramen features a rich, amber broth cradling golden noodles, topped with nori, chashu, and menma arranged neatly. Served in a white bowl on a wooden table, warm lighting highlights the steam rising from the savory, inviting dish.

segments_info.text: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, visible grain patterns, and subtle knots with smooth, slightly reflective finish.
Chashu pork: golden-brown, slightly glistening, irregularly shaped slice with visible fat marbling and tender texture.
Dark, glossy nori seaweed triangle with slightly uneven edges and visible surface texture.
The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is rich amber, glossy, and swirling around golden noodles with green garnish.
Menma bamboo shoots appear golden-brown, slightly translucent, with visible fibrous texture and green onion garnish on top.
White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface, slightly flared rim, and subtle inner rim indentation.
